svg.aria-label: Pythia-14M in fp32 is 56.3 MB, split into four fragments: each embedding is a 25.8 MB fragment and the six transformer blocks share the other two, about 2.4 MB each. Rounds rotate through the fragments every 12 or 13 steps with sync_every = 50, so a node uploads 25.8 MB, 25.8 MB, 2.4 MB and 2.4 MB in turn; keeping up takes about 1 MB/s.
svg.text: Pythia-14M in fp32, 56.3 MB, in four fragments
The plan packs tensors by size: each embedding is a fragment, and the six blocks share the other two.
What a node uploads, round by round
With sync_every=50, a round every 12 or 13 steps; two in four carry an embedding. Keeping up takes about 1 MB/s.
